Earn Beyond Milestones.

Performance-linked payouts may apply to eligible, successfully collected and verified paid onboarding or service collections associated with businesses you onboard.

First 6 months10%of Nexora’s eligible company share
Months 6–125%of Nexora’s eligible company share

How payouts work · see the calculation

For an eligible ₹15,000 collection, if Nexora’s share is 10%, the eligible company share is ₹1,500. A 10% partner payout from that share is ₹150.

For an eligible ₹1,000 collection, Nexora’s 10% share is ₹100. The partner’s 10% payout from that company share is ₹10.

Illustrative partner payout: ₹150

This is an illustrative calculation, not a guaranteed earning promise. Payouts apply only after refunds, cancellations, chargebacks, taxes and applicable deductions. No payment is made merely for recruiting another Growth Partner. Continued eligibility and program terms apply.
